right.label: OWN · MONTH ONE

On the listing. Water, sewer, trash, building insurance, pool, on-site manager.

slides.label: The dues. Not on the mortgage, always in the math.

carousels.title: The five pages in the HOA packet

slides.headline: They send two hundred pages.[[br]]Five decide it.
slides.dek: What I read first, before anyone falls in love.

slides.headline: You get a few days. The bill lasts thirty years.
slides.body: The packet arrives after your offer is accepted. Most people skim it. The five pages below are where the money is.

slides.headline: The budget and the reserve study.
rows: What the dues pay for, and whether they actually cover it.
The building's savings for roofs, plumbing, balconies. The percentage funded is the number.

slides.headline: The minutes and the master insurance.
rows: Leaks, lawsuits, and an assessment being discussed before it is billed.
Replacement cost, and a per-unit deductible your lender will accept.

slides.label: How many owners are more than sixty days behind on dues.
slides.body: Too many and the whole building stops qualifying for conventional loans. Every owner's loan, not just yours.
slides.source: Ask for the delinquency figure in writing.

slides.headline: Sixteen years in litigation support before I ever sold a home.
slides.body: Research, analysis, negotiation. The packet is the part I never rush.

slides.headline: Want the five-page checklist?
slides.body: One page. Bring it to any building, in English or по-русски.
slides.ask: For the checklist, or send me a packet and I'll read it with you.

carousels.title: The balcony report is in your sale file now

slides.headline: There is a structural report in your condo sale file now.
slides.dek: Most sellers have never read it. Most buyers don't know to ask.

slides.label: Condo sellers now hand buyers the most recent balcony inspection report.
slides.body: Exterior elevated elements: balconies, walkways, stairs. The inspection law came first. The disclosure law followed.

slides.headline: Three things the report tells you.
rows: Which balconies and walkways, and when.
Completed, scheduled, or still being discussed. That last word costs money.

slides.headline: Inspection and repairs [[hl:completed]].
slides.body: That is the version you want to be showing. It is on the listing for Unit 124, in writing.

slides.headline: Ask for the report in week one. Not in week three.
slides.body: If the work is still being discussed, the bill may be yours.

slides.headline: Buying or selling a condo?
slides.body: I'll tell you what your building's report says, in plain English or по-русски.
slides.ask: For the questions to ask, or send me the report.

carousels.title: The bill that arrives after closing

slides.headline: He closed in spring.[[br]]The bill came in summer.
slides.dek: A special assessment, and where it showed up months earlier.

slides.label: Per unit, for exterior repairs, months after a first purchase.
slides.body: One buyer's story on a public forum. Not my client. The pattern is the point: the bill was visible before it was billed.
slides.source: r/HOA · date unconfirmed · anecdote, not data

slides.headline: Two documents, months ahead.
rows: Percentage funded. Thin reserves are an assessment waiting to happen.
An assessment is discussed before it is billed. Discussed is the word to search for.

slides.headline: What is being discussed that hasn't been billed yet?
slides.body: Ask it in writing. The answer is either a number or a silence, and both tell you something.

slides.headline: Same monthly number. Different futures.

left.label: BUILDING A
left.body: Reserves funded. Work deferred. A bill is coming.

right.label: BUILDING B
right.body: Reserves funded. Roof done last year.

slides.body: Illustration only. The percentage is in the reserve study.

slides.headline: Send me the packet.
slides.body: I read reserve studies and minutes for a living before I sold homes. Still do.
slides.ask: And I'll tell you what's being discussed.

carousels.title: Do HOA fees ever go down?

slides.headline: Do HOA fees ever go down?
slides.dek: Almost never. Here is what actually moves them.

slides.headline: What pushes dues up.
rows: The biggest mover in California right now. The building's policy is inside your dues.
Deferred work gets paid eventually, by whoever owns the unit then.
Water, trash, the on-site manager. Steady, and they climb.

slides.headline: Small, steady increases. [[hl:No surprises]].
slides.body: A well-run building raises dues a little every year and never sends a bill you didn't see coming.

slides.label: On the listing, with what it covers, in writing.
slides.body: Water, sewer, trash, building insurance, pest control, pool service, landscaping, on-site manager.

slides.headline: Want to know what your dues are buying?
slides.body: Send me the budget. I'll mark what's covered and what isn't.
slides.ask: For the budget read, in English or по-русски.

carousels.title: Can I sell my condo with the tenant in it?

slides.headline: Yes, you can sell with your tenant in it.
slides.dek: The question is who you're selling to.

slides.headline: The tenant decides which pool you're in.

left.label: INVESTOR BUYER WANTS
left.body: The rent roll, the lease, the numbers.

right.label: OWNER-OCCUPIER WANTS
right.body: On closing day, and an empty unit.

slides.body: Neither is wrong. Pricing for the wrong one is.

slides.headline: Three things I look at first.
rows: Fixed term or month to month. That is the whole timeline.
Above or below market decides how the investor prices it.
A person, with notice rights. How the notice is worded changes the sale.

slides.headline: Written notice first. Then notice before every showing.
slides.body: Early, in writing, and respectful. It protects the sale as much as the tenant.
slides.source: Notice periods per California Apartment Association guidance · confirm for your lease

slides.label: One unit, leased at $2,500 and listed at $299,999. Both are mine.
slides.body: I ran it both ways for the owner. That is the plan I'll run for you.

slides.headline: Want it run both ways?
slides.body: Occupied and vacant, on one page, before you decide anything.

slides.headline: The list price is a headline.[[br]]The net sheet is the story.
slides.dek: What you walk away with, line by line.

slides.headline: Five lines between the price and your check.
rows: Yours and the buyer's side, as negotiated.
Fees on both sides of the table. Los Angeles has its own transfer tax.
The association charges to change the name on the file.
Transfers with the unit, or back to the tenant.
The check many sellers write at closing.

slides.eyebrow: THE LINE NOBODY QUOTES AT THE MAILBOX
slides.label: Median seller concession in the Valley this spring, on the sales that had one.
slides.body: More than half did. It never shows in the price the neighbor tells you.
slides.source: SFV April 2026 closed sales · one broker's MLS compilation · likely, not verified

slides.headline: Ask what you'd [[hl:keep]] before what you'd list for.
slides.body: The list price is negotiable. The net sheet is what you live with.

slides.headline: Same price, two nets.

right.label: SOLD AT ASKING, WITH A CHECK
right.body: Same price. Minus a concession. The headline never changed.

slides.headline: Want your number on one page?
slides.body: No listing agreement attached. Just the math.
slides.ask: For your net sheet, in English or по-русски.

slides.headline: You never hand the seller a dollar.
What escrow actually does.
rows: Your deposit, then the loan funds. Not the seller's, not the agent's.
The deed, the disclosures, the signed contract.
When both sides have performed. Not before.

slides.label: Business days after acceptance. That is when the deposit is due, by default.
slides.body: Typically 1 to 3 percent of the price under the standard California contract. Negotiable, and it goes to escrow, not the seller.

slides.headline: Cancel inside a contingency, on time, and the deposit [[hl:returns to you]].
slides.body: Miss the date and it may not. That is why the dates matter more than the tour.

slides.headline: Эскроу: нейтральная сторона держит деньги и документы до конца сделки.
slides.body: Escrow, in Russian, on request. Same process, your language.

slides.headline: Want the timeline dated for you?
slides.body: Every deadline on one page, in English or по-русски.

carousels.title: Three clocks start the day you're accepted

slides.headline: Seventeen. Seventeen. Twenty-one.
slides.dek: Three clocks start the day your offer is accepted. Nobody hands you the dates.

slides.headline: Three protections, three deadlines.
rows: Your window to inspect and walk away with your deposit.
If the bank's value comes in low, this is your exit.
If financing fails, this is the last door out.
slides.source: C.A.R. residential purchase agreement defaults · negotiable

slides.label: In a week. Calendar days, so weekends count inside the number.
slides.body: A 17-day window that starts on a Friday is not seventeen working days.

slides.eyebrow: WHAT I DO ON DAY ZERO
slides.headline: I date every deadline before the tour photos are even sorted.
slides.body: Then I put them in your phone. The clocks don't care who forgot.

slides.headline: Same dates. Different outcomes.

left.label: REMEMBERED ON DAY 18
left.body: The protection expired. The deposit is exposed.

right.label: DATED ON DAY 0
right.body: Removed or cancelled on purpose. Deposit protected.

slides.headline: Writing an offer this fall?
slides.body: Send me the accepted date and I'll map every deadline, in English or по-русски.

slides.headline: Первый дом в Америке.[[br]]Пять шагов, по порядку.
slides.dek: Без юридического языка. Как это работает на самом деле.

slides.headline: Одобрение, потом предложение.
rows: Банк говорит, сколько готов дать. Без этого продавец не рассматривает предложение.
Цена, условия, сроки. Продавец принимает, отклоняет или торгуется.

slides.headline: Эскроу и сроки.
rows: Нейтральная сторона держит деньги и документы. Депозит вносится в первые дни.
Осмотр, оценка, кредит. У каждого свой срок, и он считается в календарных днях.

slides.label: Закрытие: подписи, перевод денег, ключи.
slides.body: Сделка закрывается, когда обе стороны выполнили условия. Не раньше.

slides.headline: Ассоциация собственников: [[hl:за что вы платите]].
slides.body: Вода, мусор, страховка здания, бассейн, управляющий. Три документа, которые нужно попросить до покупки.

slides.headline: Хотите разобрать сделку по шагам?
slides.body: По-русски или по-английски. Без давления.
slides.ask: И я объясню процесс на вашем примере.
